name: @cms/db
description: Drizzle ORM schema and Postgres client for the CMS

scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @cms/db... build && dotenv -e ../../.env -- drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @cms/db... build && dotenv -e ../../.env -- drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:push: corepack pnpm --filter @cms/db... build && dotenv -e ../../.env -- drizzle-kit push
scripts.db:studio: corepack pnpm --filter @cms/db... build && dotenv -e ../../.env -- drizzle-kit studio
